title: 7 SMS Marketing Tools Accounting Firms Use in 2026

facts.fact: Thomson Reuters reports tax-prep peak utilization of 85-95% (2025), a third-party claim cited by the page.
Twilio publishes a US SMS base rate of $0.0083 per segment (2026), before carrier pass-through.
The page lists Twilio's extra long-code number at $1.15 per month.
The page lists Twilio's outbound MMS cost at $0.022.
SimpleTexting's starting published price is $29–$39 for 500 credits, as of August 2026.
EZ Texting's Launch plan is listed at $25 per month, or $20 per month on annual billing, as of August 2026.
SlickText's starting published price is $29 for 500 credits, as of August 2026.
TextMagic's US SMS prepaid rate is listed at $0.049 per SMS, as of August 2026.
ClickSend's Boost SMS rate is listed at approximately $0.029 per SMS, as of August 2026.
Textedly's starting published price is $29 for 500 messages, as of August 2026.
SimpleTexting lists 2,000 credits at $89 per month, with a local number adding $10, as of August 2026.
SimpleTexting charges a $4 one-time registration fee for 10DLC, according to the page's planning table.
SlickText lists 2,000 credits at $79, with carrier pass-through extra, as of August 2026.
EZ Texting Boost is listed at $75 per month and Scale at $125 per month, as of August 2026.
Twilio's cost for 2,000 SMS at its base rate is $16.60, per the page's calculation from the published rate.
TextMagic's cost for 2,000 SMS at its prepaid rate is $98, plus a $10 number and a $10 10DLC fee, as listed on the page.
ClickSend's cost for 2,000 SMS is approximately $58 at its Boost rate, per the page.
Twilio's public event schema names the inbound message event com.twilio.messaging.inbound-message.received.
facts.quote: Twilio Event Streams names that inbound packet

facts.fact: According to the page's reading of Twilio's docs, the inbound message payload includes an optOutType field when the reply is STOP.
facts.quote: an `optOutType` when the reply is STOP

facts.fact: The page states its pricing and developer docs were read in August 2026, and that it did not run a live tax-season send.
facts.quote: Public pricing pages and developer docs were read in August 2026.

facts.fact: The page was published on 2026-08-31.
SimpleTexting's 500-credit entry plan is listed at $29–$39/month in the article, depending on whether a toll-free or local number is taken (per SimpleTexting, as cited by the article).
Per the article, SimpleTexting charges extra teammates $20/month after three seats.
facts.quote: extra teammates are $20/month after three seats

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan is listed at $25/month, or $20/month when billed annually, per the article.
The article states EZ Texting's Boost plan jumps to $75/month.
The article states EZ Texting's Launch plan is capped at around 500 contacts.
The article says SlickText's RCS requires a separate $500 setup plus $200/year, though it attributes this figure to SlickText's own comparison writing rather than its pricing page.
facts.quote: RCS is a separate $500 setup plus $200/year on SlickText's own comparison writing

facts.fact: Per the article, Twilio's number rental starts near $1.15/month for a long code.
facts.quote: Number rental starts near $1.15/month for a long code.

facts.fact: The article cites Twilio's US SMS headline unit price as $0.0083 and claims real carrier-fee-inclusive bills run roughly 1.5–2× that figure (the 1.5–2× multiplier is the article's own estimate).
The article notes that Twilio multi-segment Unicode messages are limited to 70 characters per segment.
The article states TextMagic charges $0.049 per US SMS, several times Twilio's base rate.
The article says TextMagic adds $10 per month each for a number and for 10DLC registration.
facts.quote: Number and 10DLC add $10 each per month.

facts.fact: The article says ClickSend's Boost plan has a minimum top-up of $20.
The article lists Textedly's entry price as a $29 door price.
The article states Textedly's public pricing tiers start at 500 messages, and a 2,000-message tax season may require a higher tier or a sales quote.
The article says EZ Texting vendors quote setup within one business day.
facts.quote: vendor quotes setup inside one business day

facts.fact: The article says a multi-credit MMS message consumes 3 SimpleTexting credits.
The article says TextMagic inbound SMS is typically free.
Per the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics as cited by the article, there were 1,595,200 accountant jobs in 2025.
According to the Federal Trade Commission (2026), the FY2027 fee for area-code access to the National Do Not Call Registry is $85.
facts.quote: **FY2027 DNC area-code fee: $85** according to the [Federal Trade Commission]

facts.fact: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (2025), the median pay for accountants in May 2025 was $83,680.
facts.quote: **Accountant median pay, May 2025: $83,680** according to the [U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics]

facts.fact: The article states that a $29 SMS plan is the price point it cites for an SMS subscription plan.
facts.quote: A $29 SMS plan is noise next to one extra hour of partner review you avoid

facts.fact: The article advises that if a tax season's count of texts to send is over 500, the firm should skip the starter credit bucket to avoid buying overages in March.
facts.quote: If that number is over 500, skip the starter credit bucket or you will buy overages in March.
